### The Banquet Table - Warrior Mom Wisdom - Week of July 30
Author: Kristina Seymour
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/warrior-mom-wisdom/the-banquet-table-warrior-mom-wisdom-week-of-july-30.html
Passage: Exodus 25:23-30
Points:
- God prepares a rich table of blessings and fellowship for His people.
- Dwelling on anxious thoughts invites fear to invade and disrupt that fellowship.
- Psychoanalyzing fear gives it center stage rather than keeping the focus on God.
- Believers must command fear to leave in Jesus' name and rest in divine love.
- Like the Bread of the Presence, God's enduring presence and faith belong at the table's center.
